## Change

Describe the owner or shopper problem and resulting behavior.

## Verification

List relevant checks and any fixture-only or untested boundaries. For UI/state changes, include
phone/desktop behavior, persistence, request payload, and the visible result.

## Release impact

Document changed configuration, migrations, provider compatibility, upgrade steps, and user-facing
changelog notes. Explain whether the change belongs in the V1 core or an example-specific extension.

Do not attach credentials, customer data, payment bearer values, or private artwork URLs.
